blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The verified current HONEY implementation exposes setBlacklisted(wallet, status) and setPaused(bool) to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Its transfer hook rejects transfers involving blacklisted wallets and rejects all transfers while paused, so an authorized administrator can directly freeze individual holders or halt token transfers globally.
